author: Praxis I
title: BRBG-Dual-BIVG: Batch-Invariant HVG Selection + Dual BRBG
abstract: Replace standard HVG with a batch-invariant selector (BIVG) that maximizes within-batch variance and penalizes between-batch shifts using only batch labels. Integrated into Dual BRBG (ComBat+PCA64 embedding; residualized PC50 + balanced kNN graph). Goal: improve ARI/NMI without hurting mixing.
